messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick heads-up — I'm prototyping a 'ramped canary' flow for Console experiments. Goal: let creators define staged weights + per-variant throughput caps and an auto-fallback when SLA or error rate spikes.

devin tucker: Nice. Are we thinking this as a Console-only UX or also adding fields to the experiments API? :thinking:

maria gonzalez: API-first. Console will generate the payload. Need debate on naming: `stages` vs `ramp_steps`. Also need an explicit `fallback_variant` and `quota_per_minute`.

sasha ng: +1 API-first. For rate/health triggers, let's surface both `error_rate` and `p95_latency` in the rollout guards. We should avoid adding too many knobs in UI.

lee park: Agree. UX suggestion: show a compact timeline with weights and a small telemetry preview (expected token QPS) and a warning if quota is inconsistent.

omar khan: Quick sketch of API payload I used in the PoC:
```
{
  "experiment_id": "exp-123",
  "variants": [
    {"id":"v1","weight":90, "qps_cap":1000},
    {"id":"v2","weight":10, "qps_cap":150}
  ],
  "stages": [{"duration_min":30,"target_weights":[90,10]}],
  "guards": {"p95_latency_ms":800,"error_rate_pct":2},
  "fallback_variant":"v1"
}
```

chris bates: A few implementation notes:
- Server should enforce `qps_cap` at routing layer (not just Console).
- If guard trips, route to `fallback_variant` and mark experiment state `paused_by_guard`.
- Emit telemetry: `experiment.{id}.guard.triggered` with reason tags.

maria gonzalez: Good call on telemetry. Also want the Console to auto-generate a preflight check: validate that sum(weights)==100 and sum(qps_caps) >= expected_qps from customer plan; show fix suggestions.

devin tucker: Edge case: what if fallback_variant isn't compatible model family? need validation on model compatibility and optional `fallback_model_alias`.

sasha ng: Agree. Also add a `dry_run=true` option in API so customers can simulate traffic routing and get a preview of the assignment histogram.

lee park: UI microcopy: tooltip for `qps cap` = "hard routing cap; requests exceeding this will be routed to fallback or throttled per policy".

omar khan: Deploy-bot note: started canary-router feature branch -> ci passed :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy queued to staging; ETA ~10m :rocket:

maria gonzalez: Next steps: produce API spec doc + Console mockups. I'll create a quick RFC. Who wants to review?

devin tucker: I'll take API + telemetry sections.

sasha ng: I can review guards and UI copy.

chris bates: I'll help with routing enforcement and unit tests.

maria gonzalez: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll post the RFC link once created.
